options_cycle_help.message: Defaults: 25 minute フォーカス, 5 minute ブレーク, 15 minute long ブレーク every 4th cycle. Breaks on a スケジュール beat ブレーク-when-you-feel-like-it for mood and フォーカス in study samples. The exact minutes are convention, not science.

options_credit_help.message: サイトアクセスクレジット accrues while you フォーカス. Both アクセス to all sites and a single-site ロック解除 spend from the same balance. You can step away at any time without spending credit.

options_streak_help.message: The ストリーク counts days that reach the goal. One default セッション keeps the chain alive, and a freeze token repairs a missed day.

options_privacy_confirm_local_history_bo.message: This permanently deletes full URLs, フォーカス intentions, and detailed セッション events from this device. It does not clear a running セッション, which keeps its intention and the address of each タブ it is blocking. Ending the セッション clears the intention and starts a cleanup that clears every open ウェブサイト タブ, and the cleanup removes every stored address when it completes.

This permanently deletes full URLs, フォーカス intentions, and detailed セッション events from this device, plus local-only aggregate statistics. It does not clear a running セッション, which keeps its intention and the address of each タブ it is blocking. Ending the セッション clears the intention and starts a cleanup that clears every open ウェブサイト タブ, and the cleanup removes every stored address when it completes.
